key_insight: BudgetPV reduces theorem-proving generation compute by predicting which solver each subgoal needs and updating allocations using verification feedback.
engineering_relevance: Routing subgoals across heterogeneous LLMs can reserve expensive inference for harder proofs rather than applying one solver uniformly.
method: Use a cross-solver predictor to select solvers for unresolved subgoals.
Revise computation allocations as verification feedback arrives.
Train with class-weighted cross-entropy for initial assignment and plain cross-entropy for later allocation.
evidence_signal: Across Lean Workbook, miniF2F, ProofNet, and PutnamBench, BudgetPV uses less LLM generation compute than uniform allocation to solve the same number of subgoals in the evaluated solver settings.
watch_item: The abstract does not quantify savings or establish whether they outweigh predictor and verification overhead.
paper_title: Budget-Aware Predict-and-Verify Theorem Proving with Heterogeneous LLM Solvers
